title: unified-rollouts: canary+AB+shadow auto-rollback with safety guards and observability
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: production rollouts for model variants (canary, A/B, and shadow) need stronger automated rollback safety, clearer observability, and a single, declarative policy surface for ops. This PR unifies the rollout controller's policy evaluation, adds multi-metric auto-rollback rules, and wires enhanced observability (per-rollout SLO metrics and trace hooks). The goals are: 1) make canary/A-B/shadow rollouts declarative and consistent; 2) add safety guards (minimum sample sizes, cool-down windows, and staged probing) to reduce false positives; 3) expose metrics and trace points so SREs can alert and debug regressions; 4) add e2e and unit tests to verify rollback behavior. Checklist: - [x] controller + engine implementation - [x] rollout CRD schema + defaults - [x] console UI updates (status + traces) - [x] observability (metrics + dashboards) - [x] e2e tests for canary and shadow rollback paths - [x] performance bench to ensure controller latency remains acceptable - [x] docs updated (unified-rollouts.md) Backward compatibility and rollout: defaults maintain previous behavior (no auto-rollback) unless new fields are set. The rollout controller will ignore unknown fields. Rollout policy evaluation is feature flagged (rollout.unifiedPolicy = true) and will be enabled cluster-by-cluster; automation to flip the feature flag is documented in the rollout-owned runbook.
commits: 4 commits: 1) feat(rollout): add unified policy engine and evaluation loop (controller + policy.go) 2) feat(crd): extend Rollout CRD with metricThresholds, minSamples, cooldownWindow 3) feat(observability): add rollout_prometheus metrics and trace hooks; update dashboards 4) test: add e2e tests for canary/AB/shadow auto-rollback behavior and stability guards

review_comments: Aisha Patel: Requested stronger invariants around minSamples to avoid noisy metrics causing rollbacks. Suggested adding consecutiveFailureCount before triggering a rollback.
Priya Nair: Responded that consecutive failure gating was added (cooldown + consecutiveFailureCount) and updated tests to cover it.
Marco Li: Asked for more observability (per-rollout histograms for latency and success-rate). Implemented histograms and updated dashboards.
Chen Wang: Noted a potential race in controller reconcile when rollout is deleted during evaluation; fixed by adding a reconciliation guard and unit test.
Aisha Patel: Approved after follow-ups and verifying e2e results in CI; Marco approved as well. Chen provided a final ok with minor nits addressed.

merge_outcome:
Merged via squash merge into main. Squash commit message: 'unified rollouts: canary/AB/shadow auto-rollback with safety guards and observability

Adds unified policy engine, rollback thresholds, sample/cooldown guards, observability and e2e tests.' Backported patch applied to release/2026-02 for critical customers behind feature-flag. Post-merge: rollout.unifiedPolicy flag will be enabled for staging on 2026-03-03 and for production after bake window.
release_notes: Added unified rollout policies for canary/A-B/shadow with configurable metric-driven auto-rollback, sample-size guards, staged shadow probing, and rollout-level observability. Controlled by rollout.unifiedPolicy feature flag. No default behavior changes unless new CRD fields are used.
notes_for_ops: Feature is gated by rollout.unifiedPolicy. To enable, flip feature flag in chart values and monitor new metrics: rollout_auto_rollback_total, rollout_consecutive_failures, rollout_probe_success_ratio. Recommended alerts: rollout_auto_rollback_total > 0 for 5m during initial enablement and high false-positive counts. Runbook updated in docs/unified-rollouts.md#runbook.
known_issues: There is a known benign race when a rollout is rapidly created/deleted and the controller's reconcile loop observes transient conditions; covered by added guard but may still surface as spurious events in logs. We will follow up with improved leader-handling in a follow-up PR.
testing_summary: Unit tests added cover policy evaluation and edge cases (minSamples, cooldown, consecutiveFailures). E2E tests simulate canary regression and verify rollback occurs only after configured consecutive failures and minSamples. CI e2e initially flaky due to timing, fixed by increasing simulated traffic and adding wait loops. Performance benchmarks show controller loop latency increase within acceptable bounds (p50 +3ms, p95 +6ms).
